capabilities: navigate to next or previous notes with the mouse wheel in file-explorer order
scroll notes one page at a time, snapping to line boundaries
archive and unarchive files or folders
move the active file into a chosen folder
open next or previous Markdown file from commands
disambiguation: Not a presentation or slides mode; it is mouse-wheel navigation between notes plus page-by-page scrolling and archiving.
extras: The manifest carries an unre-reviewed-plugin notice; requires Obsidian 1.6.6 or newer.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to flip through consecutive notes with the mouse wheel or scroll a note one full page at a time.
summary: Wheel-based navigation that steps through Markdown notes in file-explorer order, adds page-unit scrolling, and files notes into an archive folder.
